description: This file declares functions related to configuration settings and environment variables, focusing on iterating over configurations and environmental parameters to emit trace events.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_list_config_fl
methods.description: Iterates over all config settings and emits 'def_param' events for the interesting ones to TRACE2.

methods.name: tr2_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Iterates over all interesting environment variables and emits 'def_param' events for them to TRACE2.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_set_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' event for the given key/value pair if the key is considered interesting.
